The following events took place in '''39 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Ando/Legends|Andoan]] military leader [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] employs ruthless tactics to defeat the [[Free Forces]] of the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]] at the decisive [[Battle of Raquish]], prompting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to intervene in the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]] by separating Ando and the Free Colonies and enforcing demilitarization of Ando's [[Sector/Legends|sector]] with a sizable [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] fleet.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*The [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] of [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]] engage in war with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
*[[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] and [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] meet for the first time.<ref name="FF">''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''</ref>
*[[Republic Defense Procurement plan]].<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
*Raith Sienar [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggles]] four [[Kol Huro combat droid]]s past Republic customs.<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
*Professor [[Murk Lundi]] takes a sabbatical to scour [[Kodai]] for a lost [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]].<ref name="Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref>
*[[Trisstan]] becomes the [[Godking]] of [[Abonshee|Masterhome]]. Era of prosperity begins.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> {{Circa}}
